record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Makuhita (1 star, maxPP 100) and Hariyama (2 stars, maxPP 80) declare DYNAMIC_PUNCH; both range 1, no declared passive. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index and maxPP.
record.summary: Single-target cast: the target is first given confusion (2000/4000/6000/8000 ms by stars, subject to the status rules) and then takes SPECIAL damage (raw 40/80/160/320 by stars, AP-scaled, SPE_DEF-reduced). The confusion call is made before the damage call, and the damage is dealt regardless of whether the confusion applied.

targeting.note: No area or secondary targets. The attacker passed to triggerConfusion is the caster.

effects.scaling: requested amount = raw table value; AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT).
effects.resolution: applied: then division by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x SPE_DEF), shields and other untraced modifiers; reported takenDamage includes shield damage; minimum 1 after ceil. Blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (magicBounce reflects it to the caster unless Protective Pads).

statusEffects.scaling: duration is the table value only: not scaled by AP and not luck-gated (no chance call in this strategy).
statusEffects.resolution: applied only if the target is not already confused, has no runeProtect and lacks IMMUNITY_CONFUSION; duration x1.3 in SANDSTORM, then reduced by SWIFT_SWIM (x0.7) / HYDRATION (x0.5) / WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER (x0.3) and Odd Keystone, rounded; a held Persim Berry is eaten on application. An already-confused target keeps its current timer. When it expires, confusion ends and the target's current target is cleared. The effect of confusion on the target's attacks is not described here. Applied before the damage, in the same call.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3 and 4 star columns are not reachable from the bare factory stars of the listed units. Whether other mechanics raise star counts was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None; the cast needs a target (requiresTarget true) and no position check is made in the strategy.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast re-applies confusion only if the target is not already confused.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage 40/80 and confusion 2000/4000 ms (1/2 stars). Applied damage: x (1 + AP/100), crit factor only if the cast crit, then SPE_DEF division, minimum 1; takenDamage is reported by handleDamage with shield damage included. Applied confusion: table value after status rules and duration modifiers; zero if blocked.
